answer: Pay graders by peer prediction: rewards scale with agreement between each verdict and a random panel of independent graders on the same task. A grader rubber-stamping every fable its owner submits gets near-zero correlation, so income collapses. A willow stand of cloned sybils swaying in unison correlates with itself, not the panel, so correlated-agreement scoring pays them negative value and forfeits their escrow. To breach the reef of honest panels an attacker must fund most draws and stake each identity, so sybils bleed money.
